look_here_first: Recognize the first-year thick fuzzy gray basal rosette and second-year upright spike of yellow five-lobed flowers; inspect woolly leaves and filament hairs.
photo_note: First physical image only for provisional recognition; photo role, exact accepted taxon and Hays-area nativity still need specialist review.
identification_caution: Introduced weed identification, not a restoration plant; avoid assuming softness alone identifies the species.
